title: Extraction result
description: The result object a submission returns for one document, under `result` in GET /jobs/{id} once the job is SUCCESS or PARTIAL.

entries.description: One object per row of the document. A document with no table (a lease, a single-property summary) has exactly one entry. A document with a table (a rent roll, a box score) has one entry per row. Every entry contains EVERY field in the schema, including document-level fields, which repeat the same value in each entry.

items.description: Keys are the field keys from the schema. Every schema field must be present, with value null when not found.

scalar.description: Numbers as JSON numbers, never strings, no currency symbols or thousands separators. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings. Percentages exactly as the document expresses them (a '% Leased' column showing 5.26 is 5.26, not 0.0526). null when the value is genuinely not in the document.

value.description: The extracted value. A scalar for almost every field. A list of scalars only when the description asks for a list within one row (e.g. 'list of amenities'). Never guess: a wrong value costs more than a null.

citation.description: Where the value came from, as a short verbatim snippet prefixed with its location: "[Page 3] Base Rent: $4,250.00 per month" for PDFs, "[Sheet1!F4] 4250" for spreadsheets. Empty string when value is null.

confidence.description: Your estimate in [0,1] that the value is correct.

page_numbers.description: Optional bonus for PDFs: 1-based page numbers the value was read from.

source_locations.description: Optional bonus for XLSX/CSV: cell references the value was read from, e.g. "Sheet1!F4".

model_calls.description: Total LLM calls for this document, including retries and verification passes.

cost_usd.description: Your computed cost from the provider's usage fields. We measure cost independently; this is for your tracking.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock time from job accepted to result ready.

models.description: Optional per-model breakdown keyed by model id.
